change.reference: VERIFIED: baseline with each of the 34 defaults changed in the source at 1b4697831, one run per crate with all of its defaults changed (14 tests run in nine crates: 0 passed, 14 failed, each failure naming every changed default with both values) vs treatment at 1b4697831 on the unchanged source (the same 14 tests passed, 0.004 s to 0.011 s each). The adversary pass planted 43 further changes at 1b4697831: every one of the 34 turned a test red when its constant or literal changed, alone or batched, and when the constructor took another literal. Four left the whole crate green: the patience a sink of the audio device starts with, the deadlines the OpenAI models and clients start with (two plants), and the connect bound of the client llama-server builds. At 12d77e8e3 the first is red (129 tests run: 128 passed, 1 failed, left 3s right 2s), the parts of the two OpenAI plants that a model's reader reaches are red (352 tests run: 350 passed, 2 failed; 351 passed, 1 failed), and the read timeout of Endpoint::live is red alone. Still green at 12d77e8e3, and named on the page: the deadlines the two OpenAI clients start with (352 passed) and the bound of the client llama-server builds (48 passed)
